summary: Frontend-only test of the Card-Bank coefficient, mixed payment, VAT/profit tax and WhatsApp notification features. No sales were saved: I intercepted POST /api/sales and it was never called. /sale/new: all 4 payment options are present. With a Case A row at 500: Cash total 500 with no breakdown. Card-Bank total 665, breakdown shows normal 500, card 665, fee 39.90. Mixed with cash 200: rest 300, card 399, fee 23.94, total 599. Mixed with cash 350.5: rest 149.50, card 198.84, fee 11.93, total 549.34. Cash of 500 or 0 shows the red error, and Ruaj is blocked with a toast. Switching back to Cash hides the breakdown and the cash input. /pos with a 30 cart: Card 39.90 (fee 2.39). Mixed with cash 10: rest 20, card 26.60, fee 1.60, total 36.60. Cash of 30 blocks checkout with a toast. Back to Cash shows 30 with no breakdown. /daily-flow: all 8 cards and all 7 profit-box fields render. The rates dialog shows 1.33/6/18/10 and closes with Escape; nothing was changed. The month report has all the new columns, and totals tax 37.57 is 10% of 375.68. Excel download works. PDF opens a new tab. /services: the WhatsApp button exists on every row and opens https://wa.me/38344123456?text=... for phone 044 123 456. Setting status to 'I riparuar' shows the confirm 'Telefoni është gati. Ta njoftoj klientin në WhatsApp?' and opens wa.me. The TEST service S-0004 was soft-deleted afterwards (GET now returns 404). Regression: /sales renders 13 rows. /print/sale renders for cash, card (legacy) and debt sales in A4, and in 80mm with TOTALI/Paguar. No page errors.

minor.issue: Rounding differs between frontend and backend. The frontend uses Math.round (half-up), the backend uses Python round() (banker's / float). Example: rest 12.50 × 1.33 = 16.625 shows as 16.63 in the UI but 16.62 is stored. The customer may see a total 1 cent different from the saved invoice. Use Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP in the backend, or the same epsilon rounding on both sides.

Qarkullimi Cash/Card is built from the amounts actually paid (cash_in/bank_in). Debt (Kredi) sales count in Nr. shitjeve but add 0 to Qarkullimi total. Example: 20.10 shows 3 sales with turnover 0. Confirm with the user that this is intended.

issues: Invalid mixed cash (>= total) shows no inline red error or red border. Only a toast appears on checkout, while /sale/new shows an inline error.
The 'Pastro' outline button at the top-right of the cart has very low contrast and is almost invisible.

The payment badge shows raw s.payment_method.toUpperCase() ('CARD', 'DEBT', and 'MIXED' for new sales with no colour class) instead of PAY_LABELS ('CARD-BANK', 'CASH + CARD-BANK', 'KREDI / BORXH'). The same applies to the view dialog's 'Pagesa'.
Borxh 0,00 is shown in orange for fully paid sales.
When cash is 0 or empty, the breakdown shows the 'TOTALI PËR PAGESË' card total (665) while the error is visible. This is acceptable because saving is blocked, but it could be confusing.
The option label is 'Cash + Card-Bank' in POS but 'Cash + Card-Bank (e kombinuar)' in /sale/new (inconsistent).

action_items: Align rounding between computeSplit (JS) and finance.py (Python round) so the UI total equals the stored total, for example at rest 12.50.
Use PAY_LABELS for the payment badge and view dialog in SalesPage.jsx, and add a colour for 'mixed'.
Add an inline invalid-cash error and red border to pos-cash-amount-input, as on /sale/new.
Optional: confirm with the user whether debt sales should count in Qarkullimi total.
critical_code_review_comments: SalesPage.jsx lines 66-70 and 103: raw payment_method shown.
ServicesPage notifyReady calls window.open after an awaited PATCH plus confirm(). Most browsers allow this after confirm, but some mobile browsers may block the popup.

The useRates module-level cache never refreshes in other open pages after the rates are changed in RatesDialog, until the page is reloaded (computeSplit uses stale rates; the backend still uses current rates, so the UI total could differ from the saved one).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows pass; minor design issues
